world.title: 'Iran War Has Done A Lot Of Damage': US Republican Candidate Slams Trump
world.summary: A Republican candidate criticized former President Donald Trump for his policies towards Iran, claiming they caused significant damage, including rising oil prices that contributed to inflation in the United States. This statement marked a divergence from typical party support for Trump. The candidate's remarks were made during the mid-term election campaign, focusing on issues affecting California.

world.title: 'Pak defeated, cannot fight us': Baloch rebels launch fresh strike; several killed
world.summary: The Balochistan Liberation Front (BLF) has launched multiple attacks against Pakistani security forces, claiming responsibility for the strikes. The group asserts that its fighters have killed a military intelligence officer and taken control of the Muzhani police station. The BLF stated that Pakistan is unable to counter their actions, leading to several casualties during these confrontations.

world.title: Four feet a year: How the Dead Sea is running out of water
world.summary: The Dead Sea, located at approximately 1,400 feet below sea level, is experiencing a significant decline in water levels, receding by about four feet annually. This phenomenon affects the surrounding regions, which include Israeli, Jordanian, and Palestinian territories. The ongoing water loss poses environmental challenges and impacts local economies reliant on the unique characteristics of this natural landmark.

business.title: IDFC First Bank Q2 results: Net Profit rises nearly 3-fold to Rs 1,045 crore, NII rises 21%
business.summary: IDFC First Bank reported its Q2 results on October 24, revealing a net profit increase of nearly three-fold to Rs 1,045 crore, marking a 196.9% rise in Profit After Tax. Additionally, the bank's Net Interest Income (NII) rose by 21%. These results reflect the bank's strong financial performance during the quarter, showcasing significant growth in profitability.

business.title: BYD Denza Luxury Brand India Debut Confirmed For 13th Nov 2026
business.summary: Denza, a luxury electric vehicle brand, will officially debut in India on November 13, 2026. The initial offering will be the D9 luxury MPV, followed by the Z9 GT high-performance shooting brake. This introduction marks Denza's entry into the Indian market, expanding the range of premium EV options available to consumers in the country.

business.title: BYD Denza Luxury Brand India Debut Confirmed For 13th Nov 2026
business.summary: Denza, the luxury electric vehicle brand, will officially debut in India on November 13, 2026. The initial offering will be the D9 luxury MPV, followed by the Z9 GT high-performance shooting brake. This launch marks Denza's entry into the Indian market, expanding the availability of premium electric vehicles in the region. Further details on pricing and specifications are anticipated.

technology.title: OPPO India Unveils Find X10 Series, Raising the Bar for Flagship Smartphones
technology.summary: OPPO India has launched the Find X10 Series, featuring the OPPO Find X10 and OPPO Find X10 Pro Max. This series introduces an industry-first Triple 200MP Camera System co-developed with Hasselblad and runs on the new ColorOS 17. Additionally, it boasts an 8000mAh battery, marking a significant advancement in flagship smartphone technology and performance.

technology.title: Hackers Use Spyware Ads To Turn 6,600 Genuine Websites Into 'Infection Delivery Network': Everything To Know
technology.summary: Researchers have identified that hackers have exploited at least 6,600 legitimate websites to disseminate spyware targeting iPhones. The infections initiate immediately when an advertisement is displayed on the screen. Rocky Cole, co-founder of iVerify, noted that users are not visiting malicious sites or engaging in risky behavior; the threat arises solely from the ads presented during their browsing experience.

technology.title: Satya Nadella Says AI Agents Need a ‘Kill Switch’ to Prevent Damage
technology.summary: Microsoft CEO Satya Nadella emphasizes the importance of implementing robust security measures for AI agents, highlighting the necessity of access controls, audit logs, and emergency kill switches. As AI agents increasingly perform tasks and make decisions with minimal human oversight, Nadella warns businesses about potential security risks and the need to protect sensitive information from unauthorized access.

sports.title: Afghanistan leapfrog England in ICC ODI rankings, reclaim their all-time high position after a year
sports.summary: Afghanistan has ascended to seventh place in the ICC Men's ODI team rankings, surpassing England following their victory over Zimbabwe in the tri-series final. This achievement marks Afghanistan's return to their all-time high position in the rankings, which they last held a year ago. The team's performance has significantly impacted their standing in international cricket.

sports.title: Asian Para Games conclude in Nagoya: India sign off with record 114 medals, finish fourth
sports.summary: India concluded the Aichi-Nagoya 2026 Asian Para Games with a record 114 medals, marking their best performance to date. The country finished fourth in the overall medal standings, with China leading the tally. The week-long event showcased various sports and athletes, highlighting India's growing prowess in the para-sports arena. The Games concluded successfully, celebrating athletic achievements.

sports.title: Abhishek Sharma scripts history, reaches six-hitting milestone no batter has touched before
sports.summary: India opener Abhishek Sharma made history by becoming the first batter to hit 100 sixes in the powerplay during T20 Internationals. He achieved this milestone in the second T20I against New Zealand held in Christchurch. Abhishek reached the landmark with a six over extra cover, marking a significant achievement in his cricketing career and T20 format statistics.

health.title: Doctors flag malaria, dengue risk amid construction activity
health.summary: Doctors in Mumbai have expressed concerns about rising malaria and dengue cases, attributing the increase to ongoing construction activities. A notable percentage of hospital beds are currently occupied by patients affected by these mosquito-borne diseases. Dr. Deepak Namjoshi, founder of Criticare Group, emphasized the need for heightened awareness and preventive measures to combat the health risks associated with these illnesses.

health.title: Amol Akhade and Mohana Murali Kolluri at COGC 2026: The Cancer Care Gap in Asia
health.summary: Amol Akhade and Mohana Murali Kolluri addressed the cancer care gap in Asia-Pacific at COGC 2026. They emphasized the need for improved cancer registration to accurately assess disease burden and inform service planning. Additionally, they highlighted the importance of screening and awareness initiatives to promote early intervention, particularly for symptoms affecting patients in rural communities.

health.title: WHO says breast cancer killed 6.9 lakh in 2024 and 80% had no risk factors: Screening, self-exams and knowing your normal can help catch it early
health.summary: The WHO reported that breast cancer caused 690,000 deaths in 2024, with 80% of victims lacking identifiable risk factors. Dr. Nair emphasized the importance of early detection through screening, self-examinations, and awareness of normal breast changes. While most breast changes are benign, prompt medical consultation is crucial for any new lumps or unusual symptoms.

science.title: IIT-M Faculty Makes Key Inputs to Global Study on Molecular Electronics
science.summary: Dr. Anil Kumar Singh from IIT-Madras contributed significantly to a global study on molecular electronics, collaborating with researchers from India, Israel, Germany, Denmark, and China. The team demonstrated that electric current can induce the rotation of a single molecule, enhancing electrical conduction by up to 100 times. Their findings were published in a prominent scientific journal.

science.title: A rare Nanotyrannus skeleton discovered by a Montana rancher in 2019 heads to auction for up to $9 million as scientists debate private fossil sales
science.summary: A rare Nanotyrannus skeleton, resembling a small Tyrannosaurus rex, is set to be auctioned in Manhattan for up to $9 million. Discovered by a Montana rancher in 2019, the fossil has sparked debate among scientists regarding the ethics of private fossil sales. The skeleton is currently displayed in a Manhattan lobby, awaiting potential bidders.

science.title: Should AI be treated like a human? A new paper published this week has an answer
science.summary: A new paper explores whether artificial intelligence should be treated like humans. The discussion is illustrated through an interaction with Google Gemini, which responds to a lyric from Pink Floyd's "Comfortably Numb." The AI's reply raises questions about the nature of communication with AI, highlighting the complexities of human-AI interactions and the implications of attributing human-like qualities to technology.

entertainment.title: Kriti Sanon says the same people who talk about culture used abusive language in comments on her parents’ and sister’s posts during Rakhi ad row
entertainment.summary: Kriti Sanon faced backlash for her outfit in a Raksha Bandhan advertisement, prompting a national debate. In response, she addressed the criticism on Kareena Kapoor's show, highlighting that those who discuss cultural values also used abusive language in comments about her family during the controversy. Sanon defended her attire and emphasized the inconsistency in the reactions she received.

entertainment.title: Prabhas' 'Fauzi' teaser faces backlash over Subhas Chandra Bose’s portrayal: 'The audacity to insult Netaji by making him portray as cheerleader just for the sake of aura farming of lead'
entertainment.summary: The teaser for Prabhas' film 'Fauzi,' released on October 23, has sparked controversy over its portrayal of Subhas Chandra Bose. Critics accuse the film of disrespecting Bose by depicting him in a manner they believe trivializes his legacy, referring to it as an "insult" and suggesting it is an attempt to enhance the lead actor's image.

entertainment.title: ‘What’s with the hate?’: Kriti Sanon reacts to backlash over her Raksha Bandhan ad outfit on Kareena Kapoor's talk show
entertainment.summary: Kriti Sanon experienced significant backlash on social media in August regarding her outfit in a Raksha Bandhan advertisement, with many labeling it as “revealing.” The criticism prompted the brand to withdraw the ad. In response, Kriti discussed the situation during an appearance on Kareena Kapoor Khan's talk show, 'What Women Want,' questioning the negativity surrounding her outfit choice.
